chapter_notes.single_objective_concentration: Objective 125 ('Prescribing practices') is by far the most heavily used MCC anchor in this chapter (16 of 17 OBJECTIVE_REFERENCE citations), reflecting that it is the only MCC Medical Expert objective dedicated to the general practice of safe, evidence-based, individualized prescribing - the closest MCC equivalent to a dedicated 'clinical pharmacology' objective, in the same way Chapter A concentrated on objective 74-3 ('Pre-operative medical evaluation') as its closest equivalent to a 'perioperative medicine' objective. Objective 77 ('Poisoning') and 78-12 ('Quality improvement and patient safety') are used as secondary/single-unit anchors for Therapeutic Index/toxicology framing and medication-error-prevention content respectively.
chapter_notes.no_weak_mappings: Unlike Chapters A and C, chapter CP has zero WEAK-strength mcc_evidence citations. This reflects that objective 125's enabling-objectives text is unusually broad and explicit (naming comorbidity/organ-function/genetics effects on prescribing, drug interactions, adverse-effect anticipation, and medication-error prevention individually), giving most CP study units a MODERATE-or-better direct textual anchor rather than requiring a thin/WEAK secondary citation.
